# LLM Descriptions Cache

Per-pair / per-primitive K=8 visual descriptions generated by `llm/generate.py`.

**Git policy:** raw `*.json` files are gitignored. Only the compressed tarballs (one per dataset) are committed.

## Unpack
```bash
cd cache/llm_descriptions
tar xzf ut-zappos.tar.gz       # 144 JSONs
tar xzf mit-states.tar.gz      # 2322 JSONs
```

## Repack (after regeneration)
```bash
cd cache/llm_descriptions
tar czf ut-zappos.tar.gz ut-zappos/
tar czf mit-states.tar.gz mit-states/
```

Sizes (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct K=8, 2026-05-23/24): UT-Zap 39K, MIT-States 649K.
